name: payment-method-detection
title: Payment method detection
description: Port the payment-method availability result model and parser into the existing plan-check flow. Trigger checkout detection only for a clearly identified one-month free trial (free plan, eligible trial, 100% discount, numeric duration 1 month, and well-formed matching offer); skip generic promotions, paid plans, other or unknown durations, and malformed offers. Reuse current session/proxy/traffic tracking; do not copy wreq, fingerprint, Sentinel, or registration engine. Persist sanitized checkout payment-method types/labels/session type/amount and expose them in the plan API and both account UIs. Add focused gating and parser tests.
